server.bind_port.description: TCP port the EFLite server listens on for incoming connections from Emacspeak or other clients.

server.bind_host.description: Network interface address to bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to accept connections from any network.

server.max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

server.verbose.description: Enable detailed debug logging (increases log verbosity).

paths.temp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., synthesized audio buffers). Ensure write permissions.

paths.data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data like user voice profiles and cached voices.

paths.log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Leave empty ("") to disable file logging (logs to stderr only).

voice.name.description: Default voice to use (e.g., 'us1', 'us2', 'ak1', 'bdl'). Must be installed and available in EFLite voice library.

voice.rate.description: Speech rate in words per minute. Typical range: 100–220.

voice.pitch.description: Pitch adjustment (0–100). 50 is neutral; higher values raise pitch, lower values lower it.

voice.volume.description: Output volume gain (0–100). 50 is default; increase for louder output.

clients.description: List of named client-specific configurations. Each entry overrides global settings for a named client context.

name.description: Unique identifier for this client context (e.g., 'emacs', 'screen', 'terminal').

enabled.description: Whether this client profile is active.

bind_host.description: Override host binding for this client (e.g., to isolate network access).

bind_port.description: Override port for this client. Use 0 to inherit global server port.

voice.description: Voice name for this client (overrides global default).

rate.description: Speech rate (WPM) for this client (overrides global default).

pitch.description: Pitch (0–100) for this client (overrides global default).

volume.description: Volume gain (0–100) for this client (overrides global default).
